name: jev
description: Routes Claude Code's coding decisions through TypeSafe Jev: typed choices with probabilities instead of silent judgment calls, enforced at plan approval and before questions to the user.

api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
api_key.description: Your key from https://console.typesafe.ai/keys. Stored in your system keychain. Leave empty to set it later with TYPESAFE_API_KEY; without a key every decision runs unverified.

enforcement.title: Enforcement level
enforcement.description: soft: protocol only, no gates. standard: plan, question and Bash gates. strict: adds the first-edit triage and the end-of-turn backstop. off: disabled.
